response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over a decade of strong full-stack and backend software engineering experience, his background fundamentally misaligns with the core requirements of a Principal Performance Architect. He lacks the necessary expertise in SoC/IP modeling, hardware-software co-design, and deep neural network workload optimization required for AI accelerator infrastructure.
strengths: Possesses over 15 years of robust software development experience, easily satisfying the baseline experience requirement for a BS degree holder.
Demonstrated capability in performance-oriented programming, such as building low-latency micro-services handling millions of requests per second.
Strong system architecture and leadership background, evidenced by multiple Staff Engineer roles and founding an open-source platform.
concerns: Completely lacks experience in SoC and IP modeling or hardware-software co-design.
No demonstrated expertise in deep learning workload analysis, DNN training, or inference optimization.
Missing preferred qualifications in GPU architecture and SIMD/MIMD architectural design.
